sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Bachelet takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: Michelle Bachelet becomes Chile's first woman president in March.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Penguin Revolution' student protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands of students march for education reform in May and June.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Chile
sport.summary: Chile misses Germany 2006 after finishing seventh in CONMEBOL qualifying.

geopolitical_news.headline: Transantiago transport chaos
geopolitical_news.summary: The botched February launch of Santiago's new bus system strands commuters daily.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pinochet-era reckoning continues
geopolitical_news.summary: Courts press ahead with human rights cases against former regime figures.

sport.headline: Under-20 World Cup third place
sport.summary: Chile's golden generation takes bronze in Canada; Copa América ends in the quarter-finals.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bachelet's popularity recovers
geopolitical_news.summary: Deft crisis management lifts her approval to record highs by year's end.

geopolitical_news.headline: Municipal elections favor opposition
geopolitical_news.summary: The right-wing Alianza makes significant gains in October's municipal elections, foreshadowing 2009.

sport.headline: Bielsa era takes shape
sport.summary: Marcelo Bielsa's high-pressing side climbs the World Cup qualifying table.

geopolitical_news.headline: Piñera elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Sebastián Piñera wins December's runoff, the first right-wing victory since Pinochet.

geopolitical_news.headline: Earthquake relief politics
geopolitical_news.summary: Reconstruction debates dominate politics after strong tremors rattle northern Chile during the year.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification secured
sport.summary: Chile finishes second in CONMEBOL qualifying, booking South Africa 2010 in style.

geopolitical_news.headline: Devastating 8.8 earthquake strikes
geopolitical_news.summary: The February 27 quake and tsunami kill hundreds and shatter central Chile.

geopolitical_news.headline: 33 miners rescued
geopolitical_news.summary: The October rescue from the San José mine captivates the world after 69 days underground.

sport.headline: World Cup last-16 exit
sport.summary: Bielsa's Chile thrills in South Africa before falling to Brazil.

geopolitical_news.headline: Student protests paralyze Chile
geopolitical_news.summary: Months of marches led by Vallejo and Jackson demand free, quality education.

geopolitical_news.headline: HidroAysén dam project approved
geopolitical_news.summary: The controversial Patagonia dams win approval in May amid environmental fury.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Chile loses to Venezuela on penalties in the quarter-finals of the Argentina-hosted tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Student movement persists
geopolitical_news.summary: Protests continue into a second year with marches and school occupations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Municipal elections rebuke right
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition Concertación wins key mayoralties including Santiago in October's municipal elections.

sport.headline: Coaching turmoil in qualifying
sport.summary: Borghi is sacked mid-campaign; Sampaoli takes over the stuttering side.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bachelet re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: She wins December's runoff in a landslide, returning to La Moneda.

geopolitical_news.headline: Electoral reform debates
geopolitical_news.summary: Calls grow to replace the Pinochet-era binomial voting system.

sport.headline: World Cup qualification sealed
sport.summary: Chile books Brazil 2014 with a game to spare under Sampaoli.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bachelet begins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: She takes office in March promising education reform and a new constitution.

geopolitical_news.headline: Caval corruption scandal
geopolitical_news.summary: A shady land deal involving her son damages the government's credibility.

sport.headline: World Cup last-16 heartbreak
sport.summary: Chile falls to Brazil on penalties in Belo Horizonte after Pinilla hits the bar.

geopolitical_news.headline: Corruption scandals batter elite
geopolitical_news.summary: The Caval and Soquimich cases implicate politicians and business across the spectrum.

geopolitical_news.headline: Powerful earthquake hits north
geopolitical_news.summary: A September 8.3 quake off Illapel triggers tsunamis and evacuations.

sport.headline: Copa América champions at home
sport.summary: Chile beats Argentina on penalties in Santiago for its first ever major title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pension reform demands grow
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass 'No more AFP' marches challenge the private pension system.

geopolitical_news.headline: Municipal elections punish left
geopolitical_news.summary: The right wins Santiago and key communes in October.

sport.headline: Copa América Centenario champions
sport.summary: Chile beats Argentina on penalties again to retain the title in New Jersey.

geopolitical_news.headline: Piñera re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: He beats Alejandro Guillier in December's runoff, returning to power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Abortion partially legalized
geopolitical_news.summary: Congress approves abortion in three limited circumstances in August after decades of total prohibition.

sport.headline: Confederations Cup final defeat
sport.summary: Chile loses 1-0 to Germany in Saint Petersburg after a dazzling run.

geopolitical_news.headline: Piñera begins second term
geopolitical_news.summary: He takes office in March promising growth and security.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pope Francis visits Chile
geopolitical_news.summary: The January visit is overshadowed by the church abuse crisis.

sport.headline: Chile misses the World Cup
sport.summary: A final-day defeat in São Paulo ends the golden generation's Russia 2018 dream.

geopolitical_news.headline: 'Estallido social' uprising erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: A metro fare hike in October ignites massive protests over inequality; dozens die.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitutional process agreed
geopolitical_news.summary: Parties agree in November to a referendum on replacing the Pinochet-era charter.

sport.headline: Copa América semi-final exit
sport.summary: Chile loses to Peru in Porto Alegre, ending the title defense.

geopolitical_news.headline: Plebiscite backs new constitution
geopolitical_news.summary: Nearly 80 percent vote in October to draft a replacement charter.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pandemic lockdowns bite
geopolitical_news.summary: COVID-19 hits hard; pension fund withdrawals are approved as relief.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Leagues and qualifiers halt; Vidal moves to Inter Milan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitutional convention elected
geopolitical_news.summary: Independents and leftists dominate the May vote to draft the new charter.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boric elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: Gabriel Boric beats José Antonio Kast in December's runoff at age 35.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final exit
sport.summary: Chile loses to Brazil in Rio; World Cup qualifying falters.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boric takes office
geopolitical_news.summary: The former student leader becomes Chile's youngest president in March.

geopolitical_news.headline: New constitution rejected
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters overwhelmingly reject the draft charter in September's plebiscite.

sport.headline: Chile misses Qatar World Cup
sport.summary: The golden generation's era ends without qualification for a second straight tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Second constitutional draft fails
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters reject a conservative-led draft in December, closing the process.

geopolitical_news.headline: Migration crisis strains north
geopolitical_news.summary: Record Venezuelan migrant arrivals overwhelm northern border towns, fueling heated national security debates.

sport.headline: Coaching change in qualifying
sport.summary: Berizzo departs; veteran Ricardo Gareca takes over the struggling side.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly wildfires ravage Valparaíso
geopolitical_news.summary: February fires kill over a hundred people in the worst disaster of its kind.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition wins municipal elections
geopolitical_news.summary: The right makes gains in October local votes ahead of 2025.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Chile goes out winless under Gareca in the United States.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kast wins presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: José Antonio Kast defeats Jeannette Jara in December's runoff, returning the right to power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Security dominates campaign
geopolitical_news.summary: Crime and migration shape the election as homicides rise.

sport.headline: Chile misses 2026 World Cup
sport.summary: Elimination is confirmed during qualifying, a third straight absence.
